limits: If the requesting user lacks write access to the original parent folder, the copy is created in the user's root folder instead.

params: JavaScript code to render the 3D scene
desc: Render an interactive 3D scene with custom Three.js code. Available globals: THREE, OrbitControls, EffectComposer, RenderPass, UnrealBloomPass, canvas, width, height.
limits: Renders in-chat only; no external state is written.

params: JavaScript code to execute. Has access to editor (tldraw Editor instance) and helper functions
Canvas ID to edit. Omit to create a new blank canvas
desc: Execute JavaScript code on a tldraw canvas. The code runs in the widget with access to the live editor instance. Examples show editor.createShape, editor.select, editor.getCurrentPageShapes, editor.distributeShapes, boxShapes.
limits: Omitting canvasId creates a new canvas; passing one mutates that existing canvas.

params: JavaScript code that receives spec and returns a result. Must use return to produce output
desc: Search the tldraw Editor API spec by writing JavaScript that receives a spec object and returns a result. spec contains members, categories, types.shapes, types.shapeTypes, helpers.
limits: Searches the API spec, not the canvas. Must use return to produce output.
